title: constrain-filters
intention: THE JUDGES BEFORE THE JUDGED: install the build_inspector filters that will gate the constrain brick's output BEFORE the constrain module exists. Two filters, minimal by design, each encoding a measured failure that PRECEDES the module: (1) constraint_traces — every constraint in a berthed constrain packet names a source that resolves on disk (law/charter/ticket/component); an invented constraint is fabricated attribution wearing a bound's costume. (2) constraint_bounds_complete — a constrain packet declares BOTH in-bounds and out-of-bounds, non-empty; an empty 'out' is exactly the founding failure (bounds-checking that never ran to completion). Both run through the packet jurisdiction the wire built, AND both are exposed as a pure judge (judge_constrain, owned by the inspector) that the future constrain berth door COMPOSES — one implementation, two mouths: the door refuses at berth time, the gate re-judges at promotion. The judge lives in the inspector and constrain imports it, never the reverse — the module structurally cannot shape its own acceptance criteria.
why: Akien, 2026-07-28, verbatim: 'for constraints, we set up it's inspector filters first. then build the constraints module. what do you think? it's a higher order build the test first.' The deep why is the home-field fence by construction: the judge lands in a different component behind a different write-gate than the thing it judges, so constrain is born under criteria it cannot soften. Tooth 10 survives test-first honestly: the filters' provenance failures exist BEFORE the module — the web-server carrier miss (CC-- 2026-07-28: premature convergence, bounds-checking never ran to completion) seeds bounds_complete; the fabricated-attribution class (2026-07-26: an echo label attesting an unhappened push; the librarian-ruling misattribution) seeds constraint_traces. The module that doesn't exist yet has no failures; the failures that made it NECESSARY do.
traces_to: Law 4 — the acceptance criteria are physics before the behavior exists; constrain grows INTO an installed gate
Law 6 — the judge is the inspector's, behind the inspector's write-gate; constrain composes it and cannot reach in
Law 8 — the module's first proof must pass a gate it did not write (the anti-home-field form of build-the-test-first)
tooth 10 — both filters carry dated-failure provenance in their docstrings; a filter nobody was taught by stays refused

falsifier.proves_green: proof gate: new teeth in test_inspector.py (each filter fire-and-stay-quiet on synthetic constrain berths; judge_constrain pure and identical through both mouths) under the tester's netns seal. Live gate: the chart-constrain ticket builds UNDER these filters — its first berthed packet must pass judges it did not write.
falsifier.proves_red: RED on any of: a constrain packet with an unresolvable source passing either mouth; an empty bounds.out passing; the two mouths disagreeing (door passes what the gate reds, or vice versa — one implementation is the claim); the inspector importing constrain (the direction inversion that would let the module shape its judge); a filter admitted without dated-failure provenance; the pre-installed set growing speculatively beyond the two measured failures (build-minimal holds — the rest arrive through the brick's loop as reality teaches).
falsifier.horizon: re-read when chart-constrain builds under these (the dependent ticket, the live gate); when constrain's reality teaches a third filter (it arrives through the stackable-learning-brick loop with its own dated failure, by installation); when a non-chart device berths constrain-class packets.
